Usage: agentcage cage har [OPTIONS] NAME

  Export captured HTTP traffic as HAR 1.2 JSON.

  Reads the capture JSONL file for a cage and produces standard HAR JSON
  loadable in Chrome DevTools (Network > Import HAR).

  Two perspectives are available:

    inbound   What the bot saw inside the cage (placeholders, redacted
              secrets). Safe to share. This is the default.
    outbound  What went on the wire (real injected secrets, raw server
              responses). Treat as sensitive.

Options:
  --view [inbound|outbound]       Perspective to export: inbound (cage sees,
                                  safe to share) or outbound (wire, contains
                                  secrets).  [default: inbound]
  -d, --decision [blocked|flagged|allowed]
                                  Filter by decision (repeatable).
  --host TEXT                     Filter by host (substring match, repeatable).
  --method TEXT                   Filter by HTTP method (repeatable).
  --direction [inbound|outbound]  Filter by traffic direction (repeatable).
  --since TEXT                    Time window: 1h, 30m, 7d, or ISO date.
  -n, --max-entries INTEGER       Max entries (0 = unlimited).  [default: 0]
  -o, --output PATH               Output file (default: stdout).
  --json-lines                    Output raw capture JSONL instead of HAR.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
